'''Daf Spearmaster''' was a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. When the mercenary cadre he was in were hired to train local security forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]], he traveled to the planet. Upon arrival, [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] insisted that all [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] in the group be released from their contracts. Trapped on Narg, he spent his days in the [[The Free Access Grill|Free Access Grill]].
